title: Port 1420 reserved exclusively for human dev
context: OpenKaava runs on Tauri, which starts Vite and points the webview at a fixed URL. Multiple developers and agents need to run the app simultaneously for verification.
decision: Port 1420 is reserved for `pnpm app` (Tauri dev), which only Braden runs to verify work. Agents must use `pnpm dev:agent` on port 1430 with strictPort off, stepping up to 1431/1432 if collision occurs.
consequences: Any other process holding 1420 causes the whole run to fail rather than gracefully degrading. Agents cannot assume a specific port; they must read what Vite prints. This prevents port collisions but adds operational complexity.
